article.title: Impact of weight loss and reduction of ultra-processed foods on liver fat content in MASLD: a randomized controlled trial.
article.authors: Bo S, Armandi A, Castelnuovo G
article.abstract: Dietary interventions are a cornerstone of management for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). However, it remains unclear whether specific dietary patterns confer benefits beyond weight loss. We aimed to compare the effects of different dietary strategies on liver fat and metabolic health in patients with MASLD.
